fixed: 2026-10-30, after the screens (screen1-screen6) and before the confirmation was flown
baseline: T3: BlockShapedPatchCityWorld's SwarmManager as S6 left it (d_ref 2.0, d_shield 1.6, d_obs 0.16), every S7 switch off
data: the confirmation: fresh routes (from 4000) in the scene's city and the three held-out cities (seeds 2-4), 40 cross, 30 pass and 20 street flights in each

safe.lost_km: at most T3's + 0.05 drones lost per km
safe.contact_km: at most T3's building contacts per km
safe.open: at most T3's + 0.02 share of flights ending in pieces
safe.hull: at least 0.5 of the drones on the hull

helps.v_coh: cohesive speed over the cross and pass flights at least 5% above T3's
helps.street_v_coh: cohesive speed over the street flights at least 98% of T3's
helps.cross_wrapped: surrounds at least T3's share minus 0.10 of the buildings the cross flights fly at

pick: among configurations both safe and helping, the highest penalised score (S6's: v_coh - 2.0 x lost/km - 0.5 x contacts/km - 4.0 x open share)
none: if none is both, recommend none on by default and report each switch's effect against T3
each_switch: every switch is also judged alone against T3 by the same two tests, so the page can say which helps on its own
